rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when an event or fact is surprisingly unexpected.

example.english: They startlingly completed the entire report by themselves.
example.traditional: 佢竟然一個人完成咗成份報告。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ging2 jin4 jat1 go3 jan4 jyun4 sing4 zo2 sing4 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this when the startling surprise is an unusually high degree or quality, especially before an adjective.

example.english: It is startlingly cold today, so remember to wear an extra layer.
example.traditional: 今日出奇地凍，記得着多件衫。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 ceot1 kei4 dei6 dung3 gei3 dak1 zoek6 do1 gin6 saam1
